info.name: Multi-Courier Integration Platform
info.description: Unified courier API. Start with courier_partner=mock; use urbanebolt after configuring UAT credentials.

body.raw:
{
  "order_id": "ORDER-1001",
  "courier_partner": "mock",
  "customer": {
    "name": "Amit Kumar",
    "phone": "9876543210",
    "email": "amit@example.com"
  },
  "pickup": {
    "name": "Warehouse",
    "phone": "9876543210",
    "address": "MG Road",
    "city": "Indore",
    "state": "Madhya Pradesh",
    "pincode": "452001"
  },
  "delivery": {
    "name": "Ravi Sharma",
    "phone": "9876501234",
    "address": "Vijay Nagar",
    "city": "Indore",
    "state": "Madhya Pradesh",
    "pincode": "452010"
  },
  "package": {
    "weightKg": 1.2,
    "lengthCm": 12,
    "widthCm": 10,
    "heightCm": 10,
    "description": "Books",
    "declaredValue": 100,
    "pieces": 1,
    "itemQuantity": 1
  },
  "paymentMode": "PREPAID"
}

item.name: Create UrbaneBolt UAT order (requires credentials)

body.raw:
{
  "order_id": "UB-UAT-1001",
  "courier_partner": "urbanebolt",
  "customer": {
    "name": "UAT Buyer",
    "phone": "9876543210",
    "email": "buyer@example.com"
  },
  "pickup": {
    "name": "UAT Warehouse",
    "phone": "9876543210",
    "address": "Warehouse Road",
    "city": "Indore",
    "state": "Madhya Pradesh",
    "pincode": "452001"
  },
  "delivery": {
    "name": "UAT Consignee",
    "phone": "9876501234",
    "address": "Delivery Road",
    "city": "Indore",
    "state": "Madhya Pradesh",
    "pincode": "452010"
  },
  "package": {
    "weightKg": 1,
    "lengthCm": 10,
    "widthCm": 10,
    "heightCm": 10,
    "description": "UAT parcel",
    "declaredValue": 100,
    "pieces": 1,
    "itemQuantity": 1
  },
  "paymentMode": "PREPAID"
}

item.description: Only run with your own UAT credentials and a unique order_id. Creates a real UAT shipment.
